QuestInfo.name: Asking After Icarus, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p407##k, a resident of the city. Let's go see how #p407# is doing. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p407#, a resident of #m10003000#. In a city like this, no news is the best news.

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p407#, one of our residents in #m10003000#, is doing lately. And hey, don't get the wrong idea—I'm absolutely NOT asking because I'm worried they might be doing something completely reckless or anything. Anyway, I'd appreciate it if you could go check on them for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: Oh, it's just you. Not many people bother climbing all the way up to a high place like this, you know. As you can see, I'm just staring at the sky again today. Looking at that blazing red sky makes me feel like I could just take off and fly right this second.
1.1: If there's a way to fly, I'm gonna try it no matter what. A few days ago, Big Bro #p402# told me that if you get bitten by a #o17#, you might actually be able to fly! So, pretty soon, I'm thinking of packing my adventuring gear and exploring the subway.
1.2: Come to think of it, it looked like #p411# was hiding huge bat wings or something too. I was a bit too scared to get a closer look, though. Alright! Wish me luck!

level.0: But you... your level is, like, way too low?
